source_contract.panel_rule: Parent training-derived output genes in official vocabulary, union every declared target gene measured in raw9624 and in vocabulary. All counts are real; no missing target positions imputed
source_contract.train_cell_budget: Exactly4 treated cells per eligible training target, plus all available non-targeting controls; same selected IDs and fixed matched control IDs for every model
source_contract.limitation: Parent output panel was derived from all parent training-target cells; this matches supervised update examples, not a four-cell-only acquisition experiment. Test treated responses excluded from all selection/fitting.
source_contract.primary_evaluation: 1977 vocabulary-matched parent output genes; eligible target coverage reported separately
source_contract.secondary_evaluation: All shared genes; same output supervision for GEARS, pretrained scGPT and random-init scGPT
source_contract.source_split: Same target roles as parent; no score-based target inclusion; physical test treated file opened only after model selection by runners
source_contract.control_policy: Non-targeting controls from the same gem_group are available for training and evaluation; held-out treated responses never enter training

selection_metric: validation all-gene intervention-mean MSE; fixed alpha grid; training-only response PCA32; no refit on validation responses
failure_or_limitations: Scores average interventions equally, not cells
Observed top20 absolute mean-delta genes are evaluation-only and were not supplied to the predictor
Zero-change delta Pearson is undefined and recorded blank, never presented as zero predictive correlation
No prospective clinical or efficacy prediction
